title: Arriving in St. Louis and meeting Charlie Creath, his sister and Zutty Singleton
summary: Randolph moved to St. Louis with Patterson, was introduced to Charlie Creath, was given a job by Creath's sister Marge, and met Zutty Singleton there.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: In St. Louis. Um-hum. So, then we played there for awhile and I took a notion I wanted to go to St. Louis. So, I told Patterson, I said, "Well, Patterson, we're going to St. Louis." So, I got -- I said, "All right, you want to go? Come on." Yeah. So, I got Patterson to St. Louis and

left my wife at home, because I always leave her whenever I go somewhere where I don't know where I'm going, in a way of speaking. I would leave her at home, see, because I don't to carry my wife there -- I don't know what I'm going to run into, see. So, I got a place -- a nice place, and soon I ran into her. Then, after I stayed there for awhile, I met this boy named [ ] Long and he introduced me to Charlie Creath. And Charlie Creath in turn asked me, he said, "Are you working?" I said, "No." He said, "Well, here, you take this. Take this and go to this address. My sister -- her name is Margie [Sisson.]" She was married to manager of Zutty Singleton. I guess you've heard of Singleton.
So, I went to Marg and gave her the note. So, Marg like the way I played. I don't know what I was doing -- I was just blowing. She like the way I played, so she kept me in the band there.
You say Marg was your sister?
Yeah, and Zutty played around come up from New Orleans. St. Louis for awhile; (unintelligible)
Yeah, Zutty played, certainly did. That's where I met Zutty from, from St. Louis.
When was this, about '23, something like that?
Yes, he passed about a year -- a little over a year ago -- about a year and a half ago.
Yes, he certainly did. That boy really played some drums, though.
